summary: Prioritize complete thoughts with a conservative, pressure-aware 12-second voice safety budget.

changes.title: Thought-first continuous transcription
changes.detail: Keep a coherent 10–12-second thought together when Smart Turn is available. Flush on a confirmed natural pause or a safe 12-second boundary, reduce to eight seconds when decode falls behind and six seconds under memory pressure, unavailable detection or disabled adaptive mode. Keep the microphone active and preserve raw/protected audio overlap.

changes.title: Reduce endpoint processing and safely recover long decodes
changes.detail: Reuse the existing stateful denoiser and aligned VAD scores, pass only the last eight seconds to Smart Turn and avoid redundant long waveform conversion. Recover ordinary long-decode exceptions using bounded sequential six-second windows. Preserve already-recognized parts if a batch cannot be recovered; flag partial output and disable auto-send.

changes.title: Preserve offline privacy and existing speech models
changes.detail: No new model weights, runtime download, permissions or signing changes. Add tests for adaptive limits, continuous audio, protected alignment, smaller retry windows and partial-result safety. Physical Reno10 speed and accuracy remain to be measured.
